build_build_event: build a BuildEvent message with BuildStarted payload containing uuid, build_tool_version, and command fields
parse_build_metrics: parse BuildMetrics message containing action_summary, memory_metrics, target_metrics, and timing_metrics data
test_test_result: test TestResult message with status enum, execution_info, test_attempt_duration, and cached_locally fields
summarize_build_finished: summarize BuildFinished message with overall_success, exit_code, finish_time, and anomaly_report fields
create_build_event_id: create BuildEventId with target_completed payload containing label, configuration, and aspect identifiers
